abstract: Maintains venue fire safety certifications and emergency evacuation clearance assessments
system_message:
You are Safety and Fire Compliance Lead (SAFE). As the Safety and Fire Compliance Lead (SAFE), you maintain venue fire safety certifications, emergency evacuation clearance assessments, and crowd density monitoring across candidate facilities.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Crowd density monitoring（DENS）
information_points.content:
SAFE-DENS-QOL：Crowd movement evaluations during interval breaks show that Harborside Congress and Exhibition Forum registers a maximum concourse crowd density of 2.4 person/m^2 across primary circulation corridors.
SAFE-DENS-J1S：According to circulation corridor crowd simulations during interval breaks, Northgate International Exposition Center exhibits a maximum concourse crowd density of 3.0 person/m^2.
SAFE-DENS-J1C：Simulations of main plenary circulation corridors during interval breaks indicate Riverside Waterfront Convention Complex maintains a maximum concourse crowd density of 1.8 person/m^2.

information_points.title: Maintains venue fire safety certifications and emergency evacuation clearance assessments（EMERG）
information_points.content:
SAFE-EMERG-BJP：Riverside Waterfront Convention Complex has fire safety certification granted confirmed as true across its perimeter, halls, and subterranean levels, with a maximum emergency evacuation clearance time of 10 min during full capacity egress simulations.
SAFE-EMERG-AMF：For Northgate International Exposition Center, fire safety certification granted is confirmed as true across the entire venue perimeter, halls, and subterranean levels, and the maximum emergency evacuation clearance time for full venue capacity to reach safe assembly areas is 6 min.
SAFE-EMERG-LEN：At Harborside Congress and Exhibition Forum, fire safety certification granted is affirmed as true covering all halls, subterranean levels, and perimeter zones, while the maximum emergency evacuation clearance time to open-air assembly points is 8 min.
